( 7 ) 11: \mathbf{h}^{(\ell)}\leftarrow\text{TransformerLayer}(\mathbf{h}^{(\ell-1)},\mathcal{E}_{\text{attn}}) 12: end for 13: // Variational Posterior Parameters 14: \boldsymbol{\ell}_{n}\leftarrow W_{\pi}\mathbf{h}_{n}^{(L)} , \boldsymbol{\mu}_{n}\leftarrow W_{\mu}\mathbf{h}_{n}^{(L)} , \log\boldsymbol{\sigma}_{n}\leftarrow W_{\sigma}\mathbf{h}_{n}^{(L)} 15: // Reparameterized Sampling 16: Sample stick variables v_{k}\sim\text{Beta}(c_{k},d_{k}) for k=1,\ldots,K 17: Compute stick-breaking priors \lambda_{k}^{\text{prior}}\leftarrow\log\frac{\pi_{k}}{1-\pi_{k}} 18: \lambda_{nk}^{\text{post}}\leftarrow\ell_{nk}+\lambda_{k}^{\text{prior}} 19: \tilde{b}_{nk}\leftarrow\sigma\left(\frac{\lambda_{nk}^{\text{post}}+g_{nk}}{\tau}\right) where g_{nk}\sim\text{Gumbel}(0,1) 20: r_{nk}\leftarrow\mu_{nk}+\sigma_{nk}\epsilon_{nk} where \epsilon_{nk}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) 21: \mathbf{z}_{n}\leftarrow\tilde{\mathbf{b}}_{n}\odot\mathbf{r}_{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{K} 22: // Neural Edge Decoder 23: \tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{n}\leftarrow f(\mathbf{z}_{n}) via two-layer MLP (Eq. ( 14 )) 24: Sample edge pairs \mathcal{S} (positive + negative sampling) 25: // Negative ELBO Computation 26: \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}}\leftarrow\sum_{(n,m)\in\mathcal{S}}A_{nm}\log\sigma(\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{n}^{\top}\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{m})+(1-A_{nm})\log(1-\sigma(\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{n}^{\top}\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{m})) 27: \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KL}}\leftarrow\mathrm{KL}(q(\mathbf{v})\|p(\mathbf{v}))+\mathrm{KL}(q(\mathbf{B})\|p(\mathbf{B}\mid\mathbf{v}))+\mathrm{KL}(q(\mathbf{R})\|p(\mathbf{R})) 28: \mathcal{L}\leftarrow\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KL}}-\mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} 29: Update parameters \theta,\phi via \nabla_{\theta,\phi}\mathcal{L} 30: end while
